name: plist_read
description: Read a property list — binary, XML or JSON — and return it as JSON, with Apple date values converted to ISO 8601 UTC and binary blobs summarised rather than dumped. Reads one file or every plist under a directory.

path.description: A .plist file, or a directory to walk

key.description: Return only this top-level key, or a dotted path into the structure

max_blob.description: Bytes of a binary value to include, base64 (default 64)

limit.description: Maximum files when walking a directory (default 200)
